summary: Machine-readable session-continuity contract (handoff.json, JSON Schema draft 2020-12) letting any z-harness agent (pi, Claude Code, Codex CLI) hand off to a fresh session: protocol 1.0 (7 fields) or 1.1 (adds attend_resume predicate for /z-attend yields). Producer-side is skills/z-handoff/SKILL.md (interactive) and scripts/write-handoff.sh (automated, wraps write-clear-checkpoint.sh); consumers are Hermes, /z-attend, and session-orchestration watchers.

entry_points.summary: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for handoff.json, additionalProperties:false. protocol_version enum ['1.0','1.1']; required: protocol_version, timestamp, agent, status, next_step, context_files; optional: slug (string|null), attend_resume (1.1 only, additionalProperties:false, 5 minLength:1 required sub-fields). context_files minItems:1, items {path, role enum [handoff|intent|spec|plan|tasks|ledger|workstreams|session_log|invariants|rejected_approaches|decisions_archive|verification_commands|diff|other]} — the 4 HANDOFF.md category-pointer roles (invariants/rejected_approaches/decisions_archive/verification_commands) intentionally repeat the handoff-role path.

Agent-facing slash command, disable-model-invocation:true. Phase 0: resolve RUN_ID/archive dir from Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR. Phase 1: 1a resolve slug/plan_dir; 1b write SESSION_CONTEXT.md live brief (current work/workspace state/decisions/open questions/landmines/immediate next action) before context_files assembly; 1c context_files priority (SESSION_CONTEXT.md > HANDOFF/INTENT/SPEC/PLAN/TASKS/FIX/LEDGER > workstreams.json > events.jsonl > active diff > explicit > fallback); 1d next_step (ARGUMENTS override > TASKS.md first-pending > FIX.md approach > ad-hoc, must point at SESSION_CONTEXT.md when present); 1e status (context_pressure|clean_break|complete|blocked, default clean_break); 1f agent id. Phase 2: assemble/validate (context_files non-empty, next_step non-empty unless complete). Phase 3: atomic write to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/handoff.json (workspace fallback only when slug null). Phase 4: handoff_written telemetry. Phase 5: print summary + fenced copy-paste resume block with the FULL untruncated next_step.

Automated producer, wrapped by write-clear-checkpoint.sh. Required env: Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR. Optional: Z_HARNESS_SLUG, Z_HARNESS_AGENT (default 'pi'), Z_HARNESS_MODEL, Z_HARNESS_CONTEXT_PCT, Z_HARNESS_HANDOFF_STATUS (default clean_break), Z_HARNESS_HANDOFF_NEXT_STEP override, Z_HARNESS_HANDOFF_SESSION_CONTEXT (writes SESSION_CONTEXT.md atomically, included as session_log role when written). Reads TASKS.md for task counts; reads SESSION.md YAML frontmatter (done_count, next_pending) + body sections (Decisions, Landmines, Open threads) to compose next_step. context_files built via ordered _add_ctx calls: SESSION_CONTEXT.md (if freshly written) > HANDOFF.md x5 (roles handoff/invariants/rejected_approaches/decisions_archive/verification_commands, same path) > INTENT.md > SPEC.md > PLAN.md > TASKS.md > FIX.md > workstreams.json > LEDGER.md > SESSION.md. Protocol branch: Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=0/absent -> 1.0 (no attend_resume); =1 -> 1.1 with 5 required attend env vars (ATTEND_HEAD_SHA, ATTEND_PHASE, ATTEND_DONE_SET_HASH, ATTEND_DIRTY_FP, ATTEND_SESSION_ID); any missing var -> exit 1 naming them. Atomic tmp+rename write. Stdout: 'STATUS: written bytes=<n>'.

Protocol narrative: protocol 1.0/1.1 fields, status enum, expanded 14-value context_files role enum, attend_resume predicate table, SESSION_CONTEXT.md vs SESSION.md distinction, consumer contract (detect->validate->load-in-order->pass-next_step->delete), pre-existing handoff.json overwrite rule, examples for 1.0/1.1/ad-hoc/complete.

invariants: handoff.json is always written to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR when in a plan; workspace root is the plan-less fallback only (slug null).

protocol_version '1.0' never includes attend_resume; protocol_version '1.1' always includes attend_resume with all 5 sub-fields non-empty (schema additionalProperties:false on both the top-level object and attend_resume).

All 5 attend env vars (ATTEND_HEAD_SHA, ATTEND_PHASE, ATTEND_DONE_SET_HASH, ATTEND_DIRTY_FP, ATTEND_SESSION_ID) must be non-empty before write-handoff.sh emits a 1.1 handoff; any missing var causes an immediate exit 1.
The agent field is provenance only — consumers MUST NOT branch behavior on it.
context_files must have at least 1 entry; minItems:1 enforced by schema.
next_step must be non-empty unless status is 'complete'; capped at 2000 chars (write-handoff.sh truncates to 1997+'...' if exceeded).
Atomic write always: write to .tmp.<PID> in the same directory then rename; consumer never sees a partial handoff.json.
write-handoff.sh at the /z-execute compaction breakpoint is gated by workflow.hermes_enabled=true; /z-attend calls it unconditionally at yield boundaries.
A pre-existing handoff.json is overwritten by the producer; the consumer (Hermes or /z-attend) must read and delete before a new one is written.
write-handoff.sh emits status=clean_break unconditionally; only the /z-handoff slash command (via Z_HARNESS_HANDOFF_STATUS) can set context_pressure, complete, or blocked.
SESSION_CONTEXT.md (live, /z-handoff-written) and SESSION.md (durable, context-curator-curated) are distinct artifacts; context-curator never edits SESSION_CONTEXT.md.
gotchas: write-handoff.sh exits non-zero if Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=1 but any of the 5 attend vars is empty; /z-attend must set all 5 before calling the script or the yield will fail loudly.
handoff.json path is $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR — NOT repo root or cwd. Orchestrators reading from the wrong path silently miss the file.
hermes_enabled=false (default) suppresses write-handoff.sh at the /z-execute compaction breakpoint. No handoff.json is written for Hermes consumption unless the knob is on.
An unconsumed handoff.json is silently overwritten by the next producer invocation; the prior session's resume data is lost without any warning.

write-handoff.sh's context_files array includes HANDOFF.md up to 5 times (once per category-pointer role: handoff, invariants, rejected_approaches, decisions_archive, verification_commands) — all pointing at the SAME path. A naive consumer that reads every entry re-reads the file 5x; dedupe by path if that matters.

commands/z-handoff.md no longer exists — the command source moved to skills/z-handoff/SKILL.md as part of the skills-atom migration; any doc or script still referencing commands/z-handoff.md is stale.
